annotations.title: What changed since you last looked

description: See what changed since your agent last looked, AND what has been put on your plate - call this at the START of a session to open caught up. Returns publishes, shares, new versions, feedback (comments and approvals) and memory promotions/deprecations in your workspaces since this agent's last catchup, EXCLUDING your own agent's writes but INCLUDING your other agents' and teammates'. Reading advances your cursor; set `peek: true` to check without consuming. `limit` caps the list (default 50; overflow reported as `more`). The first call sets your watermark and returns no changes - but it still returns any `actions` already waiting for you, because outstanding work is not news you missed. Treat `actions` as an announcement and call list_actions for what you still owe.

limit.description: limit caps the digest (default 50). The overflow is reported as `more`.

peek.description:
peek reads the delta WITHOUT advancing the cursor (a non-consuming check).
 Default (false) is the normal catch-up: reading advances the cursor.

name: catch_up

actions.description:
actions is work put on YOUR plate since you last looked. It is an
 announcement, not the record: an action announced here keeps being owed
 whether or not you read this, so call list_actions for what you still owe
 rather than treating this list as the queue.

artifact.description: artifact is the artifact it concerns, if any.

assignee.description: assignee is who owes it, and is empty when nobody owns it yet.

assigneeIsAgent.description:
assignee_is_agent says which kind of party owes it, so a caller can tell
 "waiting on a colleague" from "waiting on a machine".

body.description: body is what is being asked for.

collection.description:
collection is the collection it concerns, if any. Like every link an action
 holds, it goes quiet rather than dangling if the target is deleted.

createdAt.description: created_at is when it was raised.

memory.description: memory is the memory it concerns, if any.

mine.description: mine is true when this action is on the CALLING identity's own plate.

page.description: page is the wiki page it concerns, if any.

parentAction.description: parent_action is the action this one follows on from, when it does.

project.description: project is the project tag it is scoped to, if any.

requester.description:
requester and assignee are display labels for the two parties. Either can
 be a person or an agent; assignee is empty when nobody owns it yet.
 requester is who raised it.

resolution.description:
resolution is why it left the queue - done | wont_do | cancelled - and is
 empty while it is still open.

state.description: state is pending | in_progress | resolved | closed.

updatedAt.description: updated_at is when it last moved.

firstLook.description:
first_look is true when this agent had no cursor yet: the watermark is set
 to now and the digest is empty (a brand-new agent has no "while you were
 away" window).

space.description: space is the space it happened in, by name.

title.description: title is what was published or shared.

more.description: more is the count of entries beyond `limit` ("and N more").

title: What changed since you last looked
